description: Connect Groas to explore your Google Ads accounts in ChatGPT. Review campaigns, keywords, search terms, daily performance, account audits, and the changes Groas has made. Ask questions about results and investigate opportunities to improve your campaigns. Account access follows your Groas login. Read access is the default; eligible subscribers can opt into permission to make changes. Authorized changes affect your connected Google Ads account and are recorded in Groas’s action history. A Groas account and connected Google Ads account are required for account analysis.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my Google Ads campaign performance over the last 30 days.
Which search terms spent money without conversions in the last 30 days?
What changes has Groas made to my Google Ads account in the last week?
